name: org.lunenburgbudgetproject/archive
description: An independent, checkable archive of the Lunenburg, Massachusetts town and school budget. Budget lines FY17-FY27, the town ledger, staff rosters FY2011-FY2025, out-of-district placement counts, elections, and fifteen years of annual town reports - every figure traceable to a published document with a sha256. Tools are shaped so the documented mistakes cannot be made: budget history takes one stage, so a growth rate cannot be measured from an actual to a budget.
